target_customer: Frequent travelers and points and miles hobbyists who pay for premium search tools, plus free users who feed affiliate and membership revenue
problem: Finding award flight availability across many airline loyalty programs is slow and manual, so travelers spend days searching before redeeming credit card points.
business_model: Freemium consumer subscription (paid membership tiers for alerts and advanced search)
product_category: Consumer travel search for points and miles award flights

founders.name: Tim Qin
founders.background_notes: YC page says he invested in internet travel and financial services companies and began as an engineer at Lockheed Martin.

founders.name: Zi Liu
prior_employers: US Department of Defense, Oak Ridge (machine vision AI processing)

technical_complexity.rationale: A three person team had to query live award availability across a dozen airline loyalty programs and their partners, which means scraping or reverse engineering fragile airline systems at speed, but no research grade problem.

defensibility.rationale: Award search aggregation depends on access to airline endpoints and cached availability, which rivals could replicate. The later product mix (Flightmap, SkyView cached observations, alerts, hotels) suggests differentiation through speed and features rather than a structural moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent is reported to have copied the product by the research date. Direct competition came from other award search startups.

market_need_then: Points and miles redemption is a large hobbyist and credit card market, and award searches across many programs were manual and slow in 2023. Roame's own pitch is that redemption takes days rather than seconds. No hard demand figures were found in sources opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses roame.travel rather than a .com. Trademark ROAME filed August 2023 by Roame Holdings, Inc. and reported registered in October 2025 per a trademark aggregator.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led: search fast, redeem points for dream vacations.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by points and miles blogs and review sites (BoardingArea, AwardWallet, Upgraded Points, Milesopedia) and discussed on FlyerTalk, which suggests niche community awareness.

brand_strength.rationale: Known inside the points and miles niche through reviews and comparisons, but no evidence of a distinctive mascot, voice or mainstream recognition. The name resembles the unrelated ROAM luggage brand and others.

outcome_analysis: Roame remains active and has expanded from flight award search to hotel stays and a membership model, per its own site. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is unclear: only aggregators report a small round, so the company's trajectory rests mostly on product evidence and niche press coverage rather than verified financing or revenue.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators (VCBacked about 500K pre-seed Sept 2023 with YC as investor; CB Insights 500K convertible note dated Jan 2023); unverified, so no round recorded. No dated competitor sources near June 2023 were found (competitor comparisons found are vendor authored and from later years), so the list is empty. Point.me and Seats.aero existed as award search tools but their dated launch coverage was not found. Downgraded to depth 1 by orchestrator: the researcher reported no separate funding cross-check search.
